# Type-1 Solid Meshing Report — geo_0723 (case 1–383)

2026-07-24 · cvbml01 · HXT distance-field 파이프라인 · 1차 배치 + retry 3회 종료

---

## 1. 최종 결과

| 항목 | 값 |
| --- | --- |
| **# of mesh** | **367 / 383 (95.8%)** · 총 요소 **472,463,768** · 평균 1,290,884 · 중앙값 1,218,237 · 최대 2,853,725 |
| **mesh quality** | **neg-Jacobian = 0 → 366/366 전부** · min_q 중앙값 **0.1295** (p10 0.0221 · p90 0.3207 · 최악 0.00012) |
| **total time** | 1차 배치 17시간 2분 + retry 약 2시간 50분 · 케이스당 평균 6.9분 (중앙값 6.1분, 최대 26.6분) |

요소 예산 3.0M 초과 케이스 **0건** (retry 전 최대 5,078,842 → 현재 2,853,725).

### 진행 경과

| 단계 | 성공 | 누적 | 핵심 변경 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1차 배치 | 322 | 322 / 383 (84.1%) | 40분 상한, algo (2, 10) |
| retry 1 | +11 | 333 (86.9%) | 2D Delaunay 도입 |
| retry 2 | +23 | 356 (93.0%) | 20분 상한 + mesh_size 0.05→0.06 사다리 |
| retry 3 | +11 | **367 (95.8%)** | Frontal-Delaunay 사다리 |

**총 회수 45건, 전부 neg-Jacobian 0.**

---

## 2. ⚠️ 직접 지오메트리를 수정해야 하는 케이스 — **14건**

부울(STEP1/3/4) 단계에서 죽거나, 부울은 통과했지만 형상 자체가 자기교차하는 케이스입니다.
**볼륨 태그 하드코딩(`lipid=(3,3)`, `fc=(3,2)`, `lumen=(3,4)`, `solid=(3,6)`)은 정상 사양이므로 건드리지 않았습니다.** 따라서 아래는 전부 형상 쪽에서 풀어야 합니다.

### 정상 케이스의 부울 결과 (기준선 — case 2, 5로 확인)

| 단계 | 볼륨 구성 |
| --- | --- |
| STEP1 후 | `(2, fc)` `(3, lipid∩fc)` |
| STEP3 후 | `(2, fc−lumen)` `(3, lipid)` `(4, lumen)` |
| STEP4 후 | `(2)` `(3)` `(4)` `(6, solid)` → **leftover 정확히 1개** ✅ |

### 🔴 A. 입력 STEP 자기교차 — 4건 (가장 확실, 최우선)

`BOPAlgo_AlertSelfInterferingShape` 는 **입력 형상이 스스로 교차**한다는 뜻입니다. 어떤 메싱 옵션으로도 고칠 수 없습니다.

| case | selfInt | acqSelfInt | tooSmallEdge | 기타 | 상태 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **215** | **128** | 24 | 120 | unableOrient 8 | 부울은 통과, 이후 모든 메싱 조합 실패 |
| **240** | 64 | 36 | 124 | badPos 24 | `STEP4 Failed` |
| **65** | 44 | 20 | 28 | unableOrient 8 | `Unknown model region with tag 3` |
| **114** | 8 | 4 | 48 | notSplittable 4 | `Unknown OpenCASCADE entity dim 3 tag 2` |

> case 215는 자기교차 지표가 압도적으로 높습니다(128). 부울은 간신히 통과했지만 2D·3D 알고리즘 4개 조합(5/6 × 0.05/0.06)이 전부 실패했습니다 — **형상 수정 외에 방법이 없습니다.**

### 🔴 B. 음수 볼륨 발생 — 3건 (방향 뒤집힘 / 자기 관통)

부울 결과에 **부피가 음수인 솔리드**가 생깁니다. 면 방향이 뒤집혔거나 형상이 스스로를 관통한다는 신호입니다.

| case | 음수 볼륨 | 발생 지점 | 부수 증상 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **305** | **−207.22** | STEP3 후 tag 6 | fc(tag 2)가 아예 사라짐, 볼륨 4개로 파편화 |
| **343** | **−3.42** | STEP3 후 tag 2 (= fc) | STEP4에서 leftover 3개 |
| **127** | **−0.39** | STEP3 후 tag 4 | fc(tag 2)가 사라짐, 볼륨 4개로 파편화 |

> **case 305가 가장 심각합니다** — 음수 부피 −207은 solid 본체(≈150~290)에 맞먹는 크기로, 형상이 크게 잘못됐습니다.

### 🟠 C. fc가 STEP3에서 소멸 — 1건

| case | STEP3 후 볼륨 | 문제 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **10** | `(3, 14.68)` `(4, 286.81)` — **tag 2 없음** | `fc − lumen` 결과가 비어 사라짐 → fc가 lumen 안에 완전히 잠겼거나 두께가 0에 가까움 |

> 수정 방향: **fibrous cap 두께(`fc_av_th`) 확보** 또는 lumen과의 간섭 제거.

### 🟠 D. STEP4에서 lumen이 재생성 + sliver 파편 — 5건

부울은 전부 통과하지만, `solid` 컷 과정에서 **lumen(tag 4)이 소비되고 tag 7로 다시 생성**되며 미세 파편(tag 8)이 함께 남습니다. 그 결과 leftover가 3개가 되어 검사에 걸립니다.

| case | leftover (부피) | | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| | **solid 본체** | **lumen 재생성분** | **sliver 파편** |
| **27** | 147.36 | 293.69 | **0.0113** |
| **151** | 159.42 | 280.55 | **0.0090** |
| **231** | 156.23 | 292.34 | **0.1724** |
| **287** | 142.80 | 289.82 | **0.0280** |
| **376** | 156.17 | 277.80 | **0.0005** |

> sliver는 본체 대비 **100만분의 1~1000분의 1** 크기입니다. 근본 원인은 **lumen 외면과 solid 내면이 정합하지 않아** 컷 과정에서 lumen이 재구성되는 것입니다.
> 수정 방향: **lumen과 solid의 공유 경계면을 정확히 일치**시키기 (동일 곡면에서 생성, 또는 lumen을 solid에서 직접 빼서 생성).
> ※ case 343은 B(음수 볼륨)와 이 증상을 함께 가집니다.

### 🔴 E. 부울 엔진 즉시 실패 — 1건

| case | 오류 |
| --- | --- |
| **250** | `Fragments failed - BOPAlgo_AlertIntersectionFailed` — OCC가 교차 계산 자체를 포기 |

---

### 📋 지오메트리 수정 대상 최종 목록 (14건)

```
215, 240, 65, 114      ← 자기교차 (최우선)
305, 343, 127          ← 음수 볼륨
10                     ← fc 소멸 (두께 부족)
27, 151, 231, 287, 376 ← lumen/solid 경계 부정합 + sliver
250                    ← 부울 엔진 실패
```

우선순위: **305 → 215 → 240 → 65 → 343 → 127 → 114 → 10 → 250 → 27/151/231/287/376**

---

## 3. 지오메트리 수정이 **필요 없는** 미완 케이스 — 2건

| case | 상태 | 진단 | 조치 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **380** | timeout | 부울 정상, BOPAlgo 경고 0건. 2D·3D 모두 통과하고 **3D 최적화 중 20분 상한**에 걸림 (`Improving 1,292,397 tet`) | **상한만 30분으로 올리면 회수 가능성 높음** — 형상 수정 불필요 |
| **63** | failed | 부울 정상, BOPAlgo 경고 0건. `HXT 3D mesh failed` — 4개 알고리즘 조합 모두 실패 | 원인 미확정. 형상 문제라는 근거는 없음 |

---

## 4. ⚠️ 파라미터 스터디에서 flag가 필요한 케이스 — 18건

아래 케이스는 **`mesh_size = 0.06`** 으로 생성됐습니다 (나머지 349건은 **0.05**). 이산화 수준이 다르므로 결과 비교 시 반드시 표시해야 합니다.

```
1, 3, 14, 24, 52, 54, 72, 86, 202, 205, 226, 239, 261, 268, 297, 355, 359, 366
```

기록 파일: `solid_0723/coarsened_cases.json`

### 왜 0.06으로 내렸나

- **요소수가 ANSYS 해석 비용을 직접 결정**하고, 소요시간과 요소수의 상관계수가 **r = 0.815** 로 높습니다
- 요소수는 대략 (1/h)³ 이므로 **0.05 → 0.06 이면 약 58%** 로 감소합니다
- **품질 손해가 없습니다.** case 14: 요소 5,078,842 → 1,574,616 (**−69%**) 인데 min_q 는 0.106 → **0.146으로 오히려 개선**

| case | 이전 (0.05) | 이후 (0.06) | 감소 | min_q |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 14 | 5,078,842 | 1,574,616 | −69% | 0.106 → **0.146** |
| 202 | 3,595,221 | 1,449,022 | −60% | 0.111 |
| 268 | 3,061,255 | 1,269,379 | −59% | 0.206 |
| 24 | 3,025,664 | 1,344,336 | −56% | 0.094 |
| 366 | 3,082,431 | 2,110,244 | −32% | 0.132 |

---

## 5. 메싱 실패의 진짜 원인 (기술 요약)

**결론: 3D가 아니라 2D 표면 메시가 거의 모든 실패의 원인이었습니다.**

| 증상 | 겉보기 원인 | 실제 원인 | 해법 | 결과 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 40분 timeout (35건) | 3D HXT가 느림 | `Mesh.Algorithm=2`(Automatic)가 BSpline 면에서 **MeshAdapt로 폴백** → edge recovery 무한 루프. **3D에 도달조차 못함** | `Mesh.Algorithm` **2 → 5** | 40분 → **1분** |
| `HXT 3D mesh failed` (9건) | 3D 알고리즘 문제 | **표면 메시 자기교차** (`overlapping facets`, `PLC Error`) | `Mesh.Algorithm` **2 → 5** | 8/9 회수 |
| crash (exit −6, 4건) | 원인 불명 | 2D/3D 조합 | (5, 1) | **4/4 회수** |
| Delaunay도 폴백 | — | 특정 BSpline 면 | **`Mesh.Algorithm=6`** (Frontal-Delaunay) | 사다리 소진 2건(3·72) 모두 회수 |

### 재사용 가능한 교훈

1. **`Mesh.Algorithm=2`(Automatic)를 쓰지 말 것.** BSpline 면에서 MeshAdapt로 조용히 폴백해 무한정 돕니다. **5(Delaunay)** 를 기본으로.
2. **Delaunay가 실패하는 면에는 Frontal-Delaunay(6)가 통합니다.** case 3·72는 0.05·0.06 사다리를 모두 소진했는데 algo 6으로 각 **54.3초 / 71.7초** 완료.
3. **`Algorithm3D` 교체는 타임아웃에 무의미합니다.** 3D에 도달하지 못하니까요.
4. **짧은 일괄 타임아웃은 위험합니다.** 322건 실측 기준 상한 5분이면 성공 메시의 **93.5%(301건)**, 10분이면 12.4%(40건)를 잃습니다 (중앙값 6.3분, p90 15.3분).
5. **막히면 성글게(0.06) — 대개 살아나고 품질도 나빠지지 않습니다.**

### 권장 설정 (다음 배치)

| 단계 | mesh_size | Mesh.Algorithm | Mesh.Algorithm3D | 상한 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 0.05 | **5** (Delaunay) | 10 (HXT) | 20분 |
| 2 | 0.06 | **6** (Frontal-Delaunay) | 10 (HXT) | 20분 |
| 3 | 0.06 | 5 | 1 (Delaunay) | 20분 |

고정: `ElementOrder=2`, `SecondOrderLinear=1`, `Smoothing=10`, `optimize('HighOrder')`, **Netgen OFF**, distance field (fc 표면 기준 · SizeMin=mesh_size · SizeMax=0.2 · DistMax=3.0 · Sampling=1000)

---

## 6. 산출물 위치 (cvbml01)

| 항목 | 경로 |
| --- | --- |
| 메시 | `65_final_0723/solid_0723/case_<i>/dist_run/solid_type_1_dist.msh` |
| 품질 지표 | 같은 폴더 `quality.json` |
| 진행 기록 | `solid_0723/batch_progress.jsonl`, `solid_0723/retry_progress.jsonl` |
| 0.06 케이스 목록 | `solid_0723/coarsened_cases.json` |
| 케이스별 gmsh 로그 | `solid_0723/logs/case<i>_*.log` |
| 메싱 스크립트 | `HXT_meshing_I_dist.py` (`gmshing_solid(..., algo2d, algo3d)`) |
| 단일 케이스 실행 | `mesh_one_dist.py <case> <nproc> <size> [algo2d] [algo3d]` |
| 배치 | `batch_dist_0723.py`, `batch_retry_0723.py`, `batch_retry2_0723.py`, `batch_retry3_0723.py` |

**보고서를 [meshing report hxt1](https://app.notion.com/p/3a72a46dc68c8000b454f9922cb1ac81) 페이지에 작성했습니다.**

볼륨 태그 하드코딩은 정상 사양으로 두고, **정상 케이스(2, 5)의 부울 결과를 기준선으로 삼아** 실패 케이스를 하나씩 대조했습니다.

## 직접 지오메트리를 수정해야 하는 케이스 — **14건**

| 분류 | case | 근거 |
|---|---|---|
| 🔴 **자기교차** | **215, 240, 65, 114** | `SelfInterferingShape` 128 / 64 / 44 / 8회 — 입력 STEP이 스스로 교차 |
| 🔴 **음수 볼륨** | **305, 343, 127** | 부울 결과에 부피 **−207.22 / −3.42 / −0.39** 솔리드 발생 |
| 🟠 **fc 소멸** | **10** | STEP3 후 fc(tag 2)가 사라짐 — fc가 lumen에 잠기거나 두께 ≈ 0 |
| 🟠 **lumen/solid 경계 부정합** | **27, 151, 231, 287, 376** | STEP4에서 lumen이 tag 7로 재생성 + sliver(0.0005~0.17) 발생 |
| 🔴 **부울 엔진 실패** | **250** | `BOPAlgo_AlertIntersectionFailed` |

**우선순위: 305 → 215 → 240 → 65 → 343 → 127 → 114 → 10 → 250 → 27/151/231/287/376**

가장 심각한 건 **case 305**입니다 — 음수 부피 −207이 solid 본체(≈150~290)에 맞먹습니다. **case 215**는 자기교차 지표가 128로 압도적이고, 부울은 통과했지만 메싱 알고리즘 4조합이 전부 실패해서 형상 수정 외엔 방법이 없습니다.

## 지오메트리 수정이 **필요 없는** 2건
- **case 380** — 부울·2D·3D 전부 정상, **3D 최적화 중 20분 상한**에 걸린 것뿐. 상한만 30분으로 올리면 회수될 가능성이 높습니다.
- **case 63** — 부울 정상(BOPAlgo 경고 0건). `HXT 3D mesh failed`이지만 **형상 문제라는 근거는 없습니다.** 원인 미확정으로 남겨뒀습니다.

보고서에는 이 밖에 **0.06으로 만든 18건(flag 필요)**, 실패 원인 기술 분석, 다음 배치 권장 설정, 산출물 경로도 함께 정리했습니다.

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""
Mesh ONE case with the distance-field recipe (HXT_meshing_I_dist.gmshing_solid),
saving ONLY the .msh (no vtu). Prints a final one-line JSON status:
  STATUS {"case":..,"status":"done|skipped|failed", ...}

Usage: python mesh_one_dist.py <case> <nproc> <mesh_size> [algo2d] [algo3d]
       algo2d: 2 = Automatic (default, falls back to MeshAdapt), 5 = Delaunay, 6 = Frontal-Delaunay
       algo3d: 10 = HXT (default), 1 = Delaunay
"""
import sys
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
from HXT_meshing_I_dist import gmshing_solid

CASE = int(sys.argv[1])
NPROC = int(sys.argv[2])
MESH_SIZE = float(sys.argv[3])
ALGO2D = int(sys.argv[4]) if len(sys.argv) > 4 else 2
ALGO3D = int(sys.argv[5]) if len(sys.argv) > 5 else 10

geo = HERE / "geo_0723" / f"case_{CASE}"
out = HERE / "solid_0723" / f"case_{CASE}" / "dist_run"
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
final_msh = out / "solid_type_1_dist.msh"


def emit(d):
    print("STATUS " + json.dumps(d), flush=True)


if final_msh.exists():
    emit({"case": CASE, "status": "skipped"})
    sys.exit(0)

t0 = time.time()
try:
    csv = Path("/home/jeff/project/54_analysis/pre_data/bin/parameter.csv")
    lesion_length = float(pd.read_csv(str(csv)).loc[CASE, "lesion_length"])

    msh = gmshing_solid(
        geo / "lumen.stp", geo / "solid.stp", geo / "lipid.stp", geo / "fc.stp",
        str(out), nproc=NPROC, Terminal_display=True, save_vtu=False,
        mesh_size=MESH_SIZE, lesion_length=lesion_length,
        algo2d=ALGO2D, algo3d=ALGO3D,
    )
    Path(msh).replace(final_msh)   # solid_type_1.msh -> solid_type_1_dist.msh ; NO vtu

    q = {}
    qp = out / "quality.json"
    if qp.exists():
        q = json.loads(qp.read_text())
    emit({"case": CASE, "status": "done",
          "algo2d": ALGO2D, "algo3d": ALGO3D,
          "num_elements": q.get("num_elements"),
          "min_quality": q.get("min_quality"),
          "neg_jacobian": q.get("neg_jacobian_count"),
          "seconds": round(time.time() - t0, 1)})
except Exception as e:
    emit({"case": CASE, "status": "failed",
          "error": f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}",
          "seconds": round(time.time() - t0, 1)})
    sys.exit(1)

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""
Re-mesh the 18 regenerated-geometry cases (geo_0727) with the proven ladder.
These are the cases that had no mesh (16) or a mesh that failed FC extraction in
simulation (168, 381). Geometry was regenerated in WSL on 2026-07-27.

Ladder per case, each rung capped at 20 min, first success wins:
  A. algo2d=5 (Delaunay)         + algo3d=10 (HXT)      @ 0.05   <- base, matches main batch
  B. algo2d=6 (Frontal-Delaunay) + algo3d=10 (HXT)      @ 0.06
  C. algo2d=5 (Delaunay)         + algo3d=1  (Delaunay) @ 0.06

Output: solid_0727/case_<c>/dist_run/solid_type_1_dist.msh (+ quality.json).
Kept separate from solid_0723 so the geo_0723 meshes are untouched.
"""
import json
import time
import subprocess
import threading
from pathlib import Path
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PY = "/home/jeff/miniconda3/envs/ansys_new/bin/python"

CASES = [10, 27, 63, 65, 114, 127, 151, 168, 215, 231, 240, 250,
         287, 305, 343, 376, 380, 381]

NPROC = 12
WORKERS = 5
PER_CASE_TIMEOUT = 1200  # 20 min per rung
RUNGS = [(0.05, 5, 10), (0.06, 6, 10), (0.06, 5, 1)]

SOLID = HERE / "solid_0727"
LOGDIR = SOLID / "logs"; LOGDIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
PROG = SOLID / "batch_progress.jsonl"
STATUS = SOLID / "batch_status.json"
MARKER = SOLID / "batch_0727.marker"

_lock = threading.Lock()
counts = {"total": len(CASES), "done": 0, "failed": 0, "timeout": 0,
          "skipped": 0, "running": 0}
start_time = time.time()


def msh_path(c):
    return SOLID / f"case_{c}" / "dist_run" / "solid_type_1_dist.msh"


def write_status():
    with _lock:
        s = dict(counts)
        s["start_time"] = start_time
        s["elapsed"] = round(time.time() - start_time, 1)
        STATUS.write_text(json.dumps(s, indent=2))


def record(entry):
    entry["ts"] = time.time()
    with _lock:
        with open(PROG, "a") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(entry) + "\n")
        st = entry.get("status")
        if st in counts:
            counts[st] += 1
    write_status()


def attempt(c, size, a2, a3, tag):
    logf = LOGDIR / f"case{c}_{tag}.log"
    try:
        with open(logf, "w") as lf:
            p = subprocess.run(
                [PY, "mesh_one_0727.py", str(c), str(NPROC), str(size), str(a2), str(a3)],
                cwd=str(HERE), stdout=lf, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                timeout=PER_CASE_TIMEOUT,
            )
        for line in reversed(logf.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()):
            if line.startswith("STATUS "):
                return json.loads(line[len("STATUS "):])
        return {"status": "failed", "error": f"no STATUS line (exit {p.returncode})"}
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return {"status": "timeout"}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"status": "failed", "error": f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"}


def run_case(c):
    if msh_path(c).exists():
        record({"case": c, "status": "skipped"})
        return {"case": c, "status": "skipped"}
    with _lock:
        counts["running"] += 1
    write_status()
    entry = {"case": c}
    try:
        for i, (size, a2, a3) in enumerate(RUNGS):
            st = attempt(c, size, a2, a3, f"r{i+1}")
            st.update({"mesh_size": size, "algo2d": a2, "algo3d": a3, "rung": i + 1})
            entry.update(st)
            if st.get("status") == "done":
                break
    finally:
        with _lock:
            counts["running"] -= 1
    record(entry)
    return entry


def main():
    if MARKER.exists():
        MARKER.unlink()
    write_status()
    print(f"[0727] {len(CASES)} cases, {WORKERS}-wide, nproc={NPROC}, "
          f"cap={PER_CASE_TIMEOUT//60}min/rung, rungs={RUNGS}", flush=True)
    print(f"[0727] cases: {CASES}", flush=True)
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=WORKERS) as ex:
        futs = [ex.submit(run_case, c) for c in CASES]
        for fut in as_completed(futs):
            e = fut.result()
            print(f"[case {e.get('case')}] {e.get('status')} rung={e.get('rung')} "
                  f"size={e.get('mesh_size')} algo=({e.get('algo2d')},{e.get('algo3d')}) "
                  f"elem={e.get('num_elements')} min_q={e.get('min_quality')} "
                  f"neg={e.get('neg_jacobian')} {e.get('seconds')}s "
                  f"{str(e.get('error',''))[:70]}", flush=True)
    MARKER.write_text("DONE\n")
    write_status()
    print("[0727] COMPLETE")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

            if st.get("status") == "done":
                break
    finally:
        with _lock:
            counts["running"] -= 1
    record(entry)
    return entry


def main():
    if MARKER.exists():
        MARKER.unlink()
    write_status()
    print(f"[0727] {len(CASES)} cases, {WORKERS}-wide, nproc={NPROC}, "
          f"cap={PER_CASE_TIMEOUT//60}min/rung, rungs={RUNGS}", flush=True)
    print(f"[0727] cases: {CASES}", flush=True)
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=WORKERS) as ex:
        futs = [ex.submit(run_case, c) for c in CASES]
        for fut in as_completed(futs):
            e = fut.result()
            print(f"[case {e.get('case')}] {e.get('status')} rung={e.get('rung')} "
                  f"size={e.get('mesh_size')} algo=({e.get('algo2d')},{e.get('algo3d')}) "
                  f"elem={e.get('num_elements')} min_q={e.get('min_quality')} "
                  f"neg={e.get('neg_jacobian')} {e.get('seconds')}s "
                  f"{str(e.get('error',''))[:70]}", flush=True)
    MARKER.write_text("DONE\n")
    write_status()
    print("[0727] COMPLETE")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

content.text:
STEP4는 **lumen만 빼는 게 아니라, solid(외벽 블록)에서 lipid+fc+lumen 셋을 모두 빼는** 단계입니다.

## 전체 부울 파이프라인
```python
# STEP1: lipid ∩ fc        → 새 fc   (지질핵과 겹치는 부분만 fibrous cap으로)
# STEP3: fc − lumen         → 새 fc   (내강 쪽 잘라냄)
# STEP4: solid − (lipid+fc+lumen) → 새 solid   ← 지금 여기
```

STEP4 코드:
```python
solid = importShapes(solid.stp)              # 전체 동맥벽 블록
gmsh.model.occ.cut([solid], [lipid, fc, lumen])   # 세 개를 다 도려냄
...
solid = volumes - set([lipid, fc, lumen])
if len(solid) != 1:                          # ← 딱 1개 남아야 통과
    raise Exception("STEP4 Failed.")
```

즉 **외벽 덩어리에서 내강·지질핵·섬유막을 파내고 남은 "건강한 벽 조직"**이 최종 solid 도메인입니다. `len != 1` 검사에 걸리는 게 STEP4 Failed입니다.

## 왜 실패하나 (진단 결과 재확인)
정상 케이스는 컷 후 solid 1개만 남습니다. 그런데 실패 케이스(예: case 27)는 **3개**가 남았습니다:

| 남은 볼륨 | 부피 | 정체 |
|---|---|---|
| tag 6 | 147.4 | ✅ 진짜 solid (건강한 벽) |
| tag 7 | **293.7** | ⚠️ **lumen 모양이 안 지워지고 재생성됨** (정상 lumen ≈ 290) |
| tag 8 | 0.0113 | 미세 sliver 파편 |

content.text:
부분적으로는 맞지만, 정확히는 **"lumen과 solid의 접합면이 안 맞는다"**가 핵심이고, 그게 lumen 생성 쪽 문제일 가능성이 큽니다. 근거를 정리하면:

## STEP4 실패의 정확한 메커니즘
진단에서 결정적 차이가 하나 있었습니다 — **정상 케이스는 lumen이 그대로 유지되는데, 실패 케이스는 lumen이 새 볼륨으로 재생성됩니다.**

| | 정상 (case 2) | 실패 (case 27) |
|---|---|---|
| 컷 후 lumen | **tag 4 유지** (289.8) → 제외 집합에 포함 ✅ | **tag 4 사라지고 tag 7로 재생성** (293.7) → 제외 집합에 없음 ❌ |
| 결과 | leftover 1개 | leftover 3개 → 검사 실패 |

즉 정상 케이스는 `solid`의 안쪽 면과 `lumen`의 바깥 면이 **정확히 같은 면(conformal)** 이라서 OCC가 lumen을 깔끔히 빼냅니다. 실패 케이스는 두 면이 미세하게 어긋나서, OCC가 lumen 영역을 **다시 조각내어** 새 볼륨으로 남겨버립니다.

## "lumen 생성이 문제"라고 할 수 있나?
**→ STEP4 그룹(8건)에 한해서는 그렇게 볼 수 있습니다.** 단, 정확한 진술은:

- solid의 안쪽 벽면이 곧 lumen 표면이어야 하는 구조인데, **둘을 독립적으로 생성하면서 표면이 일치하지 않게 된 것**입니다.
- 따라서 고치려면 **lumen과 solid의 내벽을 같은 곡면에서 생성**하거나, lumen을 solid에서 직접 빼서 만들어야 합니다.

## ⚠️ 단, 12건 전부가 lumen 문제는 아닙니다
| 부류 | case | lumen 문제? |
|---|---|---|
| STEP4 (lumen 비접합) | 10, 27, 151, 231, 287, 343, 376, 250 | ✅ 예 |
| PLC Error (메싱 단계) | 63 | ❌ 부울 통과 후 메싱 문제 |
| Unknown model region | 65 | ❌ 다른 위상 오류 |
| Unknown OCC entity | 381 | △ 애매 |
| 자기교차 잔존 | 215 | ❌ lipid/fc 자기교차 |

**확실히 하려면 측정으로 확인하는 게 좋습니다** — 실패 케이스의 lumen 바깥면과 solid 안쪽면이 실제로 얼마나(몇 mm) 어긋나는지, 그리고 정상 케이스에선 0에 가까운지를 재보면 "lumen 생성이 원인"이 데이터로 확정됩니다.

지금 그 측정을 돌려볼까요? (케이스당 몇 초, 실패 8건 + 정상 2건 비교)

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""
Re-mesh the 18 regenerated-geometry cases (geo_0727) with the proven ladder.
These are the cases that had no mesh (16) or a mesh that failed FC extraction in
simulation (168, 381). Geometry was regenerated in WSL on 2026-07-27.

Ladder per case, each rung capped at 20 min, first success wins:
  A. algo2d=5 (Delaunay)         + algo3d=10 (HXT)      @ 0.05   <- base, matches main batch
  B. algo2d=6 (Frontal-Delaunay) + algo3d=10 (HXT)      @ 0.06
  C. algo2d=5 (Delaunay)         + algo3d=1  (Delaunay) @ 0.06

Output: solid_0727/case_<c>/dist_run/solid_type_1_dist.msh (+ quality.json).
Kept separate from solid_0723 so the geo_0723 meshes are untouched.
"""
import json
import time
import subprocess
import threading
from pathlib import Path
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PY = "/home/jeff/miniconda3/envs/ansys_new/bin/python"

CASES = [10, 27, 63, 65, 114, 127, 151, 168, 215, 231, 240, 250,
         287, 305, 343, 376, 380, 381]

NPROC = 12
WORKERS = 5
PER_CASE_TIMEOUT = 1200  # 20 min per rung
RUNGS = [(0.05, 5, 10), (0.06, 6, 10), (0.06, 5, 1)]

SOLID = HERE / "solid_0727"
LOGDIR = SOLID / "logs"; LOGDIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
PROG = SOLID / "batch_progress.jsonl"
STATUS = SOLID / "batch_status.json"
MARKER = SOLID / "batch_0727.marker"

_lock = threading.Lock()
counts = {"total": len(CASES), "done": 0, "failed": 0, "timeout": 0,
          "skipped": 0, "running": 0}
start_time = time.time()


def msh_path(c):
    return SOLID / f"case_{c}" / "dist_run" / "solid_type_1_dist.msh"


def write_status():
    with _lock:
        s = dict(counts)
        s["start_time"] = start_time
        s["elapsed"] = round(time.time() - start_time, 1)
        STATUS.write_text(json.dumps(s, indent=2))


def record(entry):
    entry["ts"] = time.time()
    with _lock:
        with open(PROG, "a") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(entry) + "\n")
        st = entry.get("status")
        if st in counts:
            counts[st] += 1
    write_status()


def attempt(c, size, a2, a3, tag):
    logf = LOGDIR / f"case{c}_{tag}.log"
    try:
        with open(logf, "w") as lf:
            p = subprocess.run(
                [PY, "mesh_one_0727.py", str(c), str(NPROC), str(size), str(a2), str(a3)],
                cwd=str(HERE), stdout=lf, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                timeout=PER_CASE_TIMEOUT,
            )
        for line in reversed(logf.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()):
            if line.startswith("STATUS "):
                return json.loads(line[len("STATUS "):])
        return {"status": "failed", "error": f"no STATUS line (exit {p.returncode})"}
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return {"status": "timeout"}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"status": "failed", "error": f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"}


def run_case(c):
    if msh_path(c).exists():
        record({"case": c, "status": "skipped"})
        return {"case": c, "status": "skipped"}
    with _lock:
        counts["running"] += 1
    write_status()
    entry = {"case": c}
    try:
        for i, (size, a2, a3) in enumerate(RUNGS):
            st = attempt(c, size, a2, a3, f"r{i+1}")
            st.update({"mesh_size": size, "algo2d": a2, "algo3d": a3, "rung": i + 1})
            entry.update(st)
            if st.get("status") == "done":
                break
    finally:
        with _lock:
            counts["running"] -= 1
    record(entry)
    return entry


def main():
    if MARKER.exists():
        MARKER.unlink()
    write_status()
    print(f"[0727] {len(CASES)} cases, {WORKERS}-wide, nproc={NPROC}, "
          f"cap={PER_CASE_TIMEOUT//60}min/rung, rungs={RUNGS}", flush=True)
    print(f"[0727] cases: {CASES}", flush=True)
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=WORKERS) as ex:
        futs = [ex.submit(run_case, c) for c in CASES]
        for fut in as_completed(futs):
            e = fut.result()
            print(f"[case {e.get('case')}] {e.get('status')} rung={e.get('rung')} "
                  f"size={e.get('mesh_size')} algo=({e.get('algo2d')},{e.get('algo3d')}) "
                  f"elem={e.get('num_elements')} min_q={e.get('min_quality')} "
                  f"neg={e.get('neg_jacobian')} {e.get('seconds')}s "
                  f"{str(e.get('error',''))[:70]}", flush=True)
    MARKER.write_text("DONE\n")
    write_status()
    print("[0727] COMPLETE")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""
Re-mesh the 9 remaining cases from the 3rd-regeneration geometry (geo_0727,
2026-07-27 17:04-17:05), with a PER-CASE tailored ladder based on where each
case stalled last time.

Groups:
  * 215, 376  -- stalled in 2D MeshAdapt fallback last time. Start directly at
                 Frontal-Delaunay (algo2d=6), which recovered the identical
                 pattern in the main batch (cases 3/54/72/297).
  * 114, 380  -- passed 2D, stalled in 3D post-processing (HighOrder / facet
                 recovery). Not an algorithm problem -- just too many elements.
                 Coarsen to 0.06 and give a longer 35-min cap.
  * 10,27,63,231,250 -- boolean/topology failures last time. Ladder with 2D
                 Delaunay, re-checking whether the new geometry fixed the cut.

Each rung capped as noted; first success wins. Output to solid_0727 (same as
before) so successful meshes accumulate; existing msh are skipped.
"""
import json
import time
import subprocess
import threading
from pathlib import Path
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PY = "/home/jeff/miniconda3/envs/ansys_new/bin/python"
NPROC = 12
WORKERS = 5

# per-case ladder: list of (mesh_size, algo2d, algo3d, cap_seconds)
PLANS = {
    # 2D MeshAdapt fallback -> Frontal-Delaunay first
    215: [(0.06, 6, 10, 1200), (0.05, 6, 10, 1200), (0.06, 5, 1, 1200)],
    376: [(0.06, 6, 10, 1200), (0.05, 6, 10, 1200), (0.06, 5, 1, 1200)],
    # reached 3D, stalled in post-processing -> coarsen + longer cap
    114: [(0.06, 5, 10, 2100), (0.06, 6, 10, 2100), (0.05, 5, 10, 2100)],
    380: [(0.06, 5, 10, 2100), (0.06, 6, 10, 2100), (0.05, 5, 10, 2100)],
    # boolean/topology failures -> ladder, re-check the cut on new geometry
    10:  [(0.05, 5, 10, 1200), (0.06, 6, 10, 1200), (0.06, 5, 1, 1200)],
    27:  [(0.05, 5, 10, 1200), (0.06, 6, 10, 1200), (0.06, 5, 1, 1200)],
    63:  [(0.05, 5, 10, 1200), (0.06, 6, 10, 1200), (0.06, 5, 1, 1200)],
    231: [(0.05, 5, 10, 1200), (0.06, 6, 10, 1200), (0.06, 5, 1, 1200)],
    250: [(0.05, 5, 10, 1200), (0.06, 6, 10, 1200), (0.06, 5, 1, 1200)],
}
CASES = sorted(PLANS)

SOLID = HERE / "solid_0727"
LOGDIR = SOLID / "logs"; LOGDIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
PROG = SOLID / "batch_b_progress.jsonl"
STATUS = SOLID / "batch_b_status.json"
MARKER = SOLID / "batch_b.marker"

_lock = threading.Lock()
counts = {"total": len(CASES), "done": 0, "failed": 0, "timeout": 0,
          "skipped": 0, "running": 0}
start_time = time.time()


def msh_path(c):
    return SOLID / f"case_{c}" / "dist_run" / "solid_type_1_dist.msh"


def write_status():
    with _lock:
        s = dict(counts)
        s["start_time"] = start_time
        s["elapsed"] = round(time.time() - start_time, 1)
        STATUS.write_text(json.dumps(s, indent=2))


def record(entry):
    entry["ts"] = time.time()
    with _lock:
        with open(PROG, "a") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(entry) + "\n")
        st = entry.get("status")
        if st in counts:
            counts[st] += 1
    write_status()


def attempt(c, size, a2, a3, cap, tag):
    logf = LOGDIR / f"case{c}_{tag}.log"
    try:
        with open(logf, "w") as lf:
            p = subprocess.run(
                [PY, "mesh_one_0727.py", str(c), str(NPROC), str(size), str(a2), str(a3)],
                cwd=str(HERE), stdout=lf, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=cap,
            )
        for line in reversed(logf.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()):
            if line.startswith("STATUS "):
                return json.loads(line[len("STATUS "):])
        return {"status": "failed", "error": f"no STATUS line (exit {p.returncode})"}
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return {"status": "timeout"}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"status": "failed", "error": f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"}


def run_case(c):
    if msh_path(c).exists():
        record({"case": c, "status": "skipped"})
        return {"case": c, "status": "skipped"}
    with _lock:
        counts["running"] += 1
    write_status()
    entry = {"case": c}
    try:
        for i, (size, a2, a3, cap) in enumerate(PLANS[c]):
            st = attempt(c, size, a2, a3, cap, f"b{i+1}")
            st.update({"mesh_size": size, "algo2d": a2, "algo3d": a3,
                       "rung": i + 1, "cap_min": cap // 60})
            entry.update(st)
            if st.get("status") == "done":
                break
    finally:
        with _lock:
            counts["running"] -= 1
    record(entry)
    return entry


def main():
    if MARKER.exists():
        MARKER.unlink()
    write_status()
    print(f"[0727b] {len(CASES)} cases, {WORKERS}-wide, nproc={NPROC}, per-case tailored plans", flush=True)
    for c in CASES:
        print(f"  case {c}: {PLANS[c]}", flush=True)
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=WORKERS) as ex:
        futs = [ex.submit(run_case, c) for c in CASES]
        for fut in as_completed(futs):
            e = fut.result()
            print(f"[case {e.get('case')}] {e.get('status')} rung={e.get('rung')} "
                  f"size={e.get('mesh_size')} algo=({e.get('algo2d')},{e.get('algo3d')}) "
                  f"elem={e.get('num_elements')} min_q={e.get('min_quality')} "
                  f"neg={e.get('neg_jacobian')} {e.get('seconds')}s "
                  f"{str(e.get('error',''))[:70]}", flush=True)
    MARKER.write_text("DONE\n")
    write_status()
    print("[0727b] COMPLETE")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

                 Delaunay, re-checking whether the new geometry fixed the cut.

Each rung capped as noted; first success wins. Output to solid_0727 (same as
before) so successful meshes accumulate; existing msh are skipped.
"""
import json
import time
import subprocess
import threading
from pathlib import Path
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PY = "/home/jeff/miniconda3/envs/ansys_new/bin/python"
NPROC = 12
WORKERS = 5

# per-case ladder: list of (mesh_size, algo2d, algo3d, cap_seconds)
PLANS = {
    # 2D MeshAdapt fallback -> Frontal-Delaunay first
    215: [(0.06, 6, 10, 1200), (0.05, 6, 10, 1200), (0.06, 5, 1, 1200)],
    376: [(0.06, 6, 10, 1200), (0.05, 6, 10, 1200), (0.06, 5, 1, 1200)],
    # reached 3D, stalled in post-processing -> coarsen + longer cap
    114: [(0.06, 5, 10, 2100), (0.06, 6, 10, 2100), (0.05, 5, 10, 2100)],
    380: [(0.06, 5, 10, 2100), (0.06, 6, 10, 2100), (0.05, 5, 10, 2100)],
    # boolean/topology failures -> ladder, re-check the cut on new geometry
    10:  [(0.05, 5, 10, 1200), (0.06, 6, 10, 1200), (0.06, 5, 1, 1200)],
    27:  [(0.05, 5, 10, 1200), (0.06, 6, 10, 1200), (0.06, 5, 1, 1200)],
    63:  [(0.05, 5, 10, 1200), (0.06, 6, 10, 1200), (0.06, 5, 1, 1200)],
    231: [(0.05, 5, 10, 1200), (0.06, 6, 10, 1200), (0.06, 5, 1, 1200)],
    250: [(0.05, 5, 10, 1200), (0.06, 6, 10, 1200), (0.06, 5, 1, 1200)],
}
CASES = sorted(PLANS)

SOLID = HERE / "solid_0727"
LOGDIR = SOLID / "logs"; LOGDIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
PROG = SOLID / "batch_b_progress.jsonl"
STATUS = SOLID / "batch_b_status.json"
MARKER = SOLID / "batch_b.marker"

_lock = threading.Lock()
counts = {"total": len(CASES), "done": 0, "failed": 0, "timeout": 0,
          "skipped": 0, "running": 0}
start_time = time.time()


def msh_path(c):
    return SOLID / f"case_{c}" / "dist_run" / "solid_type_1_dist.msh"


def write_status():
    with _lock:
        s = dict(counts)
        s["start_time"] = start_time
        s["elapsed"] = round(time.time() - start_time, 1)
        STATUS.write_text(json.dumps(s, indent=2))


def record(entry):
    entry["ts"] = time.time()
    with _lock:
        with open(PROG, "a") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(entry) + "\n")
        st = entry.get("status")
        if st in counts:
            counts[st] += 1
    write_status()


def attempt(c, size, a2, a3, cap, tag):
    logf = LOGDIR / f"case{c}_{tag}.log"
    try:
        with open(logf, "w") as lf:
            p = subprocess.run(
                [PY, "mesh_one_0727.py", str(c), str(NPROC), str(size), str(a2), str(a3)],
                cwd=str(HERE), stdout=lf, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=cap,
            )
        for line in reversed(logf.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()):
            if line.startswith("STATUS "):
                return json.loads(line[len("STATUS "):])
        return {"status": "failed", "error": f"no STATUS line (exit {p.returncode})"}
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return {"status": "timeout"}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"status": "failed", "error": f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"}


def run_case(c):
    if msh_path(c).exists():
        record({"case": c, "status": "skipped"})
        return {"case": c, "status": "skipped"}
    with _lock:
        counts["running"] += 1
    write_status()
    entry = {"case": c}
    try:
        for i, (size, a2, a3, cap) in enumerate(PLANS[c]):
            st = attempt(c, size, a2, a3, cap, f"b{i+1}")
            st.update({"mesh_size": size, "algo2d": a2, "algo3d": a3,
                       "rung": i + 1, "cap_min": cap // 60})
            entry.update(st)
            if st.get("status") == "done":
                break
    finally:
        with _lock:
            counts["running"] -= 1
    record(entry)
    return entry


def main():
    if MARKER.exists():
        MARKER.unlink()
    write_status()
    print(f"[0727b] {len(CASES)} cases, {WORKERS}-wide, nproc={NPROC}, per-case tailored plans", flush=True)
    for c in CASES:
        print(f"  case {c}: {PLANS[c]}", flush=True)
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=WORKERS) as ex:
        futs = [ex.submit(run_case, c) for c in CASES]
        for fut in as_completed(futs):
            e = fut.result()
            print(f"[case {e.get('case')}] {e.get('status')} rung={e.get('rung')} "
                  f"size={e.get('mesh_size')} algo=({e.get('algo2d')},{e.get('algo3d')}) "
                  f"elem={e.get('num_elements')} min_q={e.get('min_quality')} "
                  f"neg={e.get('neg_jacobian')} {e.get('seconds')}s "
                  f"{str(e.get('error',''))[:70]}", flush=True)
    MARKER.write_text("DONE\n")
    write_status()
    print("[0727b] COMPLETE")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""
Re-mesh the final 6 cases after the user halved `alpha` (lipid-only shape param)
and regenerated ONLY lipid.stp (2026-07-27 17:24). fc/lumen/solid unchanged.
Smaller lipid should fix the boolean failures where lipid.fc no longer overlapped
(STEP1) and the lipid self-intersections that stalled meshing.

Per-case tailored plans (first success wins):
  * 215, 376  -- 2D MeshAdapt fallback before -> Frontal-Delaunay (algo2d=6) first.
  * 114       -- passed boolean, stalled in post/1D -> coarsen 0.06, algo5, 35min.
  * 10,63,231 -- boolean failures (STEP1/OCC) -> ladder, re-check the cut.
"""
import json
import time
import subprocess
import threading
from pathlib import Path
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PY = "/home/jeff/miniconda3/envs/ansys_new/bin/python"
NPROC = 12
WORKERS = 6

# per-case: list of (mesh_size, algo2d, algo3d, cap_seconds)
PLANS = {
    215: [(0.06, 6, 10, 1200), (0.05, 6, 10, 1200), (0.06, 5, 1, 1200)],
    376: [(0.06, 6, 10, 1200), (0.05, 6, 10, 1200), (0.06, 5, 1, 1200)],
    114: [(0.06, 5, 10, 2100), (0.06, 6, 10, 2100), (0.05, 5, 10, 2100)],
    10:  [(0.05, 5, 10, 1200), (0.06, 6, 10, 1200), (0.06, 5, 1, 1200)],
    63:  [(0.05, 5, 10, 1200), (0.06, 6, 10, 1200), (0.06, 5, 1, 1200)],
    231: [(0.05, 5, 10, 1200), (0.06, 6, 10, 1200), (0.06, 5, 1, 1200)],
}
CASES = sorted(PLANS)

SOLID = HERE / "solid_0727"
LOGDIR = SOLID / "logs"; LOGDIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
PROG = SOLID / "batch_c_progress.jsonl"
STATUS = SOLID / "batch_c_status.json"
MARKER = SOLID / "batch_c.marker"

_lock = threading.Lock()
counts = {"total": len(CASES), "done": 0, "failed": 0, "timeout": 0,
          "skipped": 0, "running": 0}
start_time = time.time()


def msh_path(c):
    return SOLID / f"case_{c}" / "dist_run" / "solid_type_1_dist.msh"


def write_status():
    with _lock:
        s = dict(counts)
        s["start_time"] = start_time
        s["elapsed"] = round(time.time() - start_time, 1)
        STATUS.write_text(json.dumps(s, indent=2))


def record(entry):
    entry["ts"] = time.time()
    with _lock:
        with open(PROG, "a") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(entry) + "\n")
        st = entry.get("status")
        if st in counts:
            counts[st] += 1
    write_status()


def attempt(c, size, a2, a3, cap, tag):
    logf = LOGDIR / f"case{c}_{tag}.log"
    try:
        with open(logf, "w") as lf:
            p = subprocess.run(
                [PY, "mesh_one_0727.py", str(c), str(NPROC), str(size), str(a2), str(a3)],
                cwd=str(HERE), stdout=lf, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=cap,
            )
        for line in reversed(logf.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()):
            if line.startswith("STATUS "):
                return json.loads(line[len("STATUS "):])
        return {"status": "failed", "error": f"no STATUS line (exit {p.returncode})"}
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return {"status": "timeout"}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"status": "failed", "error": f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"}


def run_case(c):
    if msh_path(c).exists():
        record({"case": c, "status": "skipped"})
        return {"case": c, "status": "skipped"}
    with _lock:
        counts["running"] += 1
    write_status()
    entry = {"case": c}
    try:
        for i, (size, a2, a3, cap) in enumerate(PLANS[c]):
            st = attempt(c, size, a2, a3, cap, f"c{i+1}")
            st.update({"mesh_size": size, "algo2d": a2, "algo3d": a3,
                       "rung": i + 1, "cap_min": cap // 60})
            entry.update(st)
            if st.get("status") == "done":
                break
    finally:
        with _lock:
            counts["running"] -= 1
    record(entry)
    return entry


def main():
    if MARKER.exists():
        MARKER.unlink()
    write_status()
    print(f"[0727c] {len(CASES)} cases, {WORKERS}-wide, nproc={NPROC}, lipid halved-alpha", flush=True)
    for c in CASES:
        print(f"  case {c}: {PLANS[c]}", flush=True)
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=WORKERS) as ex:
        futs = [ex.submit(run_case, c) for c in CASES]
        for fut in as_completed(futs):
            e = fut.result()
            print(f"[case {e.get('case')}] {e.get('status')} rung={e.get('rung')} "
                  f"size={e.get('mesh_size')} algo=({e.get('algo2d')},{e.get('algo3d')}) "
                  f"elem={e.get('num_elements')} min_q={e.get('min_quality')} "
                  f"neg={e.get('neg_jacobian')} {e.get('seconds')}s "
                  f"{str(e.get('error',''))[:70]}", flush=True)
    MARKER.write_text("DONE\n")
    write_status()
    print("[0727c] COMPLETE")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

중요한 패턴이 나옵니다.

## 실패 3개의 파라미터

| case | 결과 | lipid_length_ratio | alpha | DOS |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **63** | ❌ STEP1 | **0.434** (하위권) | 64.65 | 0.67 |
| **231** | ❌ STEP1 | **0.407** (거의 최소) | 98.25 | 0.71 |
| **376** | ❌ STEP4 | 0.800 (**최대**) | 55.2 | 0.70 |

전체 분포: min 0.380 / median 0.595 / max 0.810

## 핵심 발견 — STEP1 실패(63·231)는 **lipid_length_ratio가 너무 작다**

- **63·231은 lipid_length_ratio가 0.41~0.43으로 하위권** (median 0.595보다 한참 아래, 최소 0.38에 근접)
- lipid_length_ratio가 작다 = **지질핵이 축방향으로 짧다** → 섬유막(fc)과 겹치는 영역이 작아짐 → `lipid ∩ fc`(STEP1)가 비어서 실패
- 게다가 **DOS가 0.67~0.71로 높습니다** (성공 케이스들은 0.42~0.60) — 협착이 심하면 형상이 더 극단적

→ **앞서 예상한 게 맞습니다**: 63·231은 lipid가 작아서 fc와 안 겹치는 겁니다. 방금 alpha를 절반으로 줄여 lipid를 **더 작게** 만들었으니 STEP1이 여전히(오히려 더) 실패하는 게 당연합니다.

## 376(STEP4 실패)은 반대 — lipid_length_ratio가 **최대(0.800)**
- 지질핵이 너무 길어서 부울 컷(STEP4)에서 위상 문제 발생

## 정리
| case | 문제 | 방향 |
|---|---|---|
| 63, 231 | lipid_length_ratio 너무 **작음** (0.41~0.43) + DOS 높음 | ratio를 **키우거나**, alpha를 **되돌려/늘려야** (줄인 건 역효과) |
| 376 | lipid_length_ratio 너무 **큼** (0.800) | ratio를 **줄여야** |

즉 **63·231에 대한 alpha 절반 조치는 방향이 반대**였을 가능성이 큽니다. 이 케이스들은 lipid_length_ratio 자체를 조정하는 게 근본 해법으로 보입니다.

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""
Final retry for the 2 cases that only stall in 2D surface meshing (114, 215),
now at mesh_size 0.05 (finer -> resolves tight BSpline curvature, fewer invalid
2D elements that trigger the MeshAdapt fallback), Frontal-Delaunay first.

Ladder per case (first success wins):
  A. 0.05, algo2d=6 (Frontal-Delaunay), algo3d=10 (HXT)   cap 25 min
  B. 0.05, algo2d=5 (Delaunay),         algo3d=10 (HXT)   cap 25 min
  C. 0.05, algo2d=6 (Frontal-Delaunay), algo3d=1  (Delaunay) cap 25 min
"""
import json
import time
import subprocess
import threading
from pathlib import Path
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PY = "/home/jeff/miniconda3/envs/ansys_new/bin/python"
NPROC = 12
WORKERS = 2
CAP = 1500  # 25 min per rung

PLANS = {
    114: [(0.05, 6, 10), (0.05, 5, 10), (0.05, 6, 1)],
    215: [(0.05, 6, 10), (0.05, 5, 10), (0.05, 6, 1)],
}
CASES = sorted(PLANS)

SOLID = HERE / "solid_0727"
LOGDIR = SOLID / "logs"; LOGDIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
PROG = SOLID / "batch_d_progress.jsonl"
STATUS = SOLID / "batch_d_status.json"
MARKER = SOLID / "batch_d.marker"

_lock = threading.Lock()
counts = {"total": len(CASES), "done": 0, "failed": 0, "timeout": 0,
          "skipped": 0, "running": 0}
start_time = time.time()


def msh_path(c):
    return SOLID / f"case_{c}" / "dist_run" / "solid_type_1_dist.msh"


def write_status():
    with _lock:
        s = dict(counts)
        s["start_time"] = start_time
        s["elapsed"] = round(time.time() - start_time, 1)
        STATUS.write_text(json.dumps(s, indent=2))


def record(entry):
    entry["ts"] = time.time()
    with _lock:
        with open(PROG, "a") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(entry) + "\n")
        st = entry.get("status")
        if st in counts:
            counts[st] += 1
    write_status()


def attempt(c, size, a2, a3, tag):
    logf = LOGDIR / f"case{c}_{tag}.log"
    try:
        with open(logf, "w") as lf:
            p = subprocess.run(
                [PY, "mesh_one_0727.py", str(c), str(NPROC), str(size), str(a2), str(a3)],
                cwd=str(HERE), stdout=lf, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=CAP,
            )
        for line in reversed(logf.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()):
            if line.startswith("STATUS "):
                return json.loads(line[len("STATUS "):])
        return {"status": "failed", "error": f"no STATUS line (exit {p.returncode})"}
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return {"status": "timeout"}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"status": "failed", "error": f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"}


def run_case(c):
    if msh_path(c).exists():
        record({"case": c, "status": "skipped"})
        return {"case": c, "status": "skipped"}
    with _lock:
        counts["running"] += 1
    write_status()
    entry = {"case": c}
    try:
        for i, (size, a2, a3) in enumerate(PLANS[c]):
            st = attempt(c, size, a2, a3, f"d{i+1}")
            st.update({"mesh_size": size, "algo2d": a2, "algo3d": a3, "rung": i + 1})
            entry.update(st)
            if st.get("status") == "done":
                break
    finally:
        with _lock:
            counts["running"] -= 1
    record(entry)
    return entry


def main():
    if MARKER.exists():
        MARKER.unlink()
    write_status()
    print(f"[0727d] {len(CASES)} cases, {WORKERS}-wide, nproc={NPROC}, size 0.05, "
          f"Frontal-Delaunay first, cap {CAP//60}min/rung", flush=True)
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=WORKERS) as ex:
        futs = [ex.submit(run_case, c) for c in CASES]
        for fut in as_completed(futs):
            e = fut.result()
            print(f"[case {e.get('case')}] {e.get('status')} rung={e.get('rung')} "
                  f"size={e.get('mesh_size')} algo=({e.get('algo2d')},{e.get('algo3d')}) "
                  f"elem={e.get('num_elements')} min_q={e.get('min_quality')} "
                  f"neg={e.get('neg_jacobian')} {e.get('seconds')}s "
                  f"{str(e.get('error',''))[:70]}", flush=True)
    MARKER.write_text("DONE\n")
    write_status()
    print("[0727d] COMPLETE")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""
Final retry for the 2 cases that only stall in 2D surface meshing (114, 215),
now at mesh_size 0.05 (finer -> resolves tight BSpline curvature, fewer invalid
2D elements that trigger the MeshAdapt fallback), Frontal-Delaunay first.

Ladder per case (first success wins):
  A. 0.05, algo2d=6 (Frontal-Delaunay), algo3d=10 (HXT)   cap 25 min
  B. 0.05, algo2d=5 (Delaunay),         algo3d=10 (HXT)   cap 25 min
  C. 0.05, algo2d=6 (Frontal-Delaunay), algo3d=1  (Delaunay) cap 25 min
"""
import json
import time
import subprocess
import threading
from pathlib import Path
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PY = "/home/jeff/miniconda3/envs/ansys_new/bin/python"
NPROC = 12
WORKERS = 2
CAP = 1500  # 25 min per rung

PLANS = {
    114: [(0.05, 6, 10), (0.05, 5, 10), (0.05, 6, 1)],
    215: [(0.05, 6, 10), (0.05, 5, 10), (0.05, 6, 1)],
}
CASES = sorted(PLANS)

SOLID = HERE / "solid_0727"
LOGDIR = SOLID / "logs"; LOGDIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
PROG = SOLID / "batch_d_progress.jsonl"
STATUS = SOLID / "batch_d_status.json"
MARKER = SOLID / "batch_d.marker"

_lock = threading.Lock()
counts = {"total": len(CASES), "done": 0, "failed": 0, "timeout": 0,
          "skipped": 0, "running": 0}
start_time = time.time()


def msh_path(c):
    return SOLID / f"case_{c}" / "dist_run" / "solid_type_1_dist.msh"


def write_status():
    with _lock:
        s = dict(counts)
        s["start_time"] = start_time
        s["elapsed"] = round(time.time() - start_time, 1)
        STATUS.write_text(json.dumps(s, indent=2))


def record(entry):
    entry["ts"] = time.time()
    with _lock:
        with open(PROG, "a") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(entry) + "\n")
        st = entry.get("status")
        if st in counts:
            counts[st] += 1
    write_status()


def attempt(c, size, a2, a3, tag):
    logf = LOGDIR / f"case{c}_{tag}.log"
    try:
        with open(logf, "w") as lf:
            p = subprocess.run(
                [PY, "mesh_one_0727.py", str(c), str(NPROC), str(size), str(a2), str(a3)],
                cwd=str(HERE), stdout=lf, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=CAP,
            )
        for line in reversed(logf.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()):
            if line.startswith("STATUS "):
                return json.loads(line[len("STATUS "):])
        return {"status": "failed", "error": f"no STATUS line (exit {p.returncode})"}
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return {"status": "timeout"}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"status": "failed", "error": f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"}


def run_case(c):
    if msh_path(c).exists():
        record({"case": c, "status": "skipped"})
        return {"case": c, "status": "skipped"}
    with _lock:
        counts["running"] += 1
    write_status()
    entry = {"case": c}
    try:
        for i, (size, a2, a3) in enumerate(PLANS[c]):
            st = attempt(c, size, a2, a3, f"d{i+1}")
            st.update({"mesh_size": size, "algo2d": a2, "algo3d": a3, "rung": i + 1})
            entry.update(st)
            if st.get("status") == "done":
                break
    finally:
        with _lock:
            counts["running"] -= 1
    record(entry)
    return entry


def main():
    if MARKER.exists():
        MARKER.unlink()
    write_status()
    print(f"[0727d] {len(CASES)} cases, {WORKERS}-wide, nproc={NPROC}, size 0.05, "
          f"Frontal-Delaunay first, cap {CAP//60}min/rung", flush=True)
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=WORKERS) as ex:
        futs = [ex.submit(run_case, c) for c in CASES]
        for fut in as_completed(futs):
            e = fut.result()
            print(f"[case {e.get('case')}] {e.get('status')} rung={e.get('rung')} "
                  f"size={e.get('mesh_size')} algo=({e.get('algo2d')},{e.get('algo3d')}) "
                  f"elem={e.get('num_elements')} min_q={e.get('min_quality')} "
                  f"neg={e.get('neg_jacobian')} {e.get('seconds')}s "
                  f"{str(e.get('error',''))[:70]}", flush=True)
    MARKER.write_text("DONE\n")
    write_status()
    print("[0727d] COMPLETE")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

진단이 명확해졌습니다. **63·231은 길이가 아니라 lipid의 반경 방향(굵기/위치)이 문제**입니다.

## 정상 vs 실패 — lipid이 fc 안에 들어가는지 비교

| case | 결과 | lipid∩fc | lipid x-반경 | fc x-반경 | 판정 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 | ✅ | 3.47 | 1.034 | 1.158 | lipid이 fc 안에 잘 들어감 (여유 0.12) |
| 27 | ✅ | 1.85 | 1.082 | 1.171 | 안에 들어감 (여유 0.09) |
| **63** | ❌ | **1.59** | 0.922 | 1.179 | 겹침은 있으나 lipid이 **너무 가늘고 길다**(z −4.5~6.0) → 하류 위상 붕괴 |
| **231** | ❌ | **EMPTY** | **1.226** | 1.184 | lipid이 **fc보다 굵어서 밖으로 튀어나감** (x 1.226 > fc 1.184, y도 1.355 > 1.108) |

## 두 케이스가 서로 **반대** 문제입니다
- **231**: lipid이 fc보다 **굵고 +y로 치우쳐서**(중심 +0.25) 밖으로 삐져나감 → 교집합이 아예 안 생김
- **63**: lipid이 **너무 가늘고 길어서** 교집합(1.59)은 생기지만 이후 부울에서 얇은 sliver 위상이 깨짐

**→ 길이(ratio)를 0.80으로 키운 게 오히려 63을 더 가늘고 길게 만들었을 수 있습니다.** 231은 alpha를 절반으로 줄였는데도 여전히 굵어서 밖으로 나갑니다.

## 시도해볼 것 (3가지)

**① fc_av_th 늘리기 (가장 강력, 두 케이스 공통)**
- 현재 **0.01 cm = 0.1mm로 극단적으로 얇습니다**. 섬유막이 이렇게 얇으면 lipid와 겹칠 여유가 거의 없습니다
- **0.01 → 0.02~0.03**으로 키우면 겹침 창이 넓어져 63·231 둘 다 안정적인 부울이 됩니다

**② alpha를 케이스별로 반대 방향 조정**
- **231**: lipid이 굵어서 튀어나가니 alpha를 **더 줄여** 가늘게 (fc 안에 들어가도록)
- **63**: lipid이 가늘어서 sliver → alpha를 **키워** 굵게 (교집합을 두껍게)
- (지금은 둘 다 절반으로 줄인 상태라 63엔 역효과)

**③ ratio 되돌리기 (63)**

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""
Retry 63 and 231 with the newly regenerated lipid (2026-07-27 17:50).
Both fail at the boolean stage, so this re-checks the cut on the new geometry.
Standard ladder; boolean failures fall through in seconds.
"""
import json
import time
import subprocess
import threading
from pathlib import Path
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PY = "/home/jeff/miniconda3/envs/ansys_new/bin/python"
NPROC = 12
WORKERS = 2
CAP = 1200

PLANS = {
    63:  [(0.05, 5, 10), (0.06, 6, 10), (0.06, 5, 1)],
    231: [(0.05, 5, 10), (0.06, 6, 10), (0.06, 5, 1)],
}
CASES = sorted(PLANS)

SOLID = HERE / "solid_0727"
LOGDIR = SOLID / "logs"; LOGDIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
PROG = SOLID / "batch_e_progress.jsonl"
STATUS = SOLID / "batch_e_status.json"
MARKER = SOLID / "batch_e.marker"

_lock = threading.Lock()
counts = {"total": len(CASES), "done": 0, "failed": 0, "timeout": 0,
          "skipped": 0, "running": 0}
start_time = time.time()


def msh_path(c):
    return SOLID / f"case_{c}" / "dist_run" / "solid_type_1_dist.msh"


def write_status():
    with _lock:
        s = dict(counts)
        s["start_time"] = start_time
        s["elapsed"] = round(time.time() - start_time, 1)
        STATUS.write_text(json.dumps(s, indent=2))


def record(entry):
    entry["ts"] = time.time()
    with _lock:
        with open(PROG, "a") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(entry) + "\n")
        st = entry.get("status")
        if st in counts:
            counts[st] += 1
    write_status()


def attempt(c, size, a2, a3, tag):
    logf = LOGDIR / f"case{c}_{tag}.log"
    try:
        with open(logf, "w") as lf:
            p = subprocess.run(
                [PY, "mesh_one_0727.py", str(c), str(NPROC), str(size), str(a2), str(a3)],
                cwd=str(HERE), stdout=lf, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=CAP,
            )
        for line in reversed(logf.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()):
            if line.startswith("STATUS "):
                return json.loads(line[len("STATUS "):])
        return {"status": "failed", "error": f"no STATUS line (exit {p.returncode})"}
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return {"status": "timeout"}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"status": "failed", "error": f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"}


def run_case(c):
    if msh_path(c).exists():
        record({"case": c, "status": "skipped"})
        return {"case": c, "status": "skipped"}
    with _lock:
        counts["running"] += 1
    write_status()
    entry = {"case": c}
    try:
        for i, (size, a2, a3) in enumerate(PLANS[c]):
            st = attempt(c, size, a2, a3, f"e{i+1}")
            st.update({"mesh_size": size, "algo2d": a2, "algo3d": a3, "rung": i + 1})
            entry.update(st)
            if st.get("status") == "done":
                break
    finally:
        with _lock:
            counts["running"] -= 1
    record(entry)
    return entry


def main():
    if MARKER.exists():
        MARKER.unlink()
    write_status()
    print(f"[0727e] {len(CASES)} cases (63,231), new lipid 17:50", flush=True)
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=WORKERS) as ex:
        futs = [ex.submit(run_case, c) for c in CASES]
        for fut in as_completed(futs):
            e = fut.result()
            print(f"[case {e.get('case')}] {e.get('status')} rung={e.get('rung')} "
                  f"size={e.get('mesh_size')} algo=({e.get('algo2d')},{e.get('algo3d')}) "
                  f"elem={e.get('num_elements')} min_q={e.get('min_quality')} "
                  f"neg={e.get('neg_jacobian')} {e.get('seconds')}s "
                  f"{str(e.get('error',''))[:70]}", flush=True)
    MARKER.write_text("DONE\n")
    write_status()
    print("[0727e] COMPLETE")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""
Ladder re-mesh case 168 from the ORIGINAL geometry geo_0723 (14:59) via
mesh_one_dist.py (which reads geo_0723 and writes solid_0723/case_168/dist_run).
The tuned 16:14 geometry that meshed successfully was overwritten by the 17:56
regeneration, so this uses the original as the available "previous" geometry.

Ladder (each rung 25-min cap, first success wins):
  A. 0.05, algo2d=5 (Delaunay),         algo3d=10 (HXT)
  B. 0.06, algo2d=6 (Frontal-Delaunay), algo3d=10 (HXT)
  C. 0.06, algo2d=5 (Delaunay),         algo3d=1  (Delaunay)
"""
import json
import time
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PY = "/home/jeff/miniconda3/envs/ansys_new/bin/python"
CASE = 168
NPROC = 12
CAP = 1500
RUNGS = [(0.05, 5, 10), (0.06, 6, 10), (0.06, 5, 1)]

SOLID = HERE / "solid_0723"
LOGDIR = SOLID / "logs"; LOGDIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
PROG = SOLID / "case168_geo0723_progress.jsonl"
MARKER = SOLID / "case168_geo0723.marker"
final = SOLID / f"case_{CASE}" / "dist_run" / "solid_type_1_dist.msh"


def attempt(size, a2, a3, tag):
    logf = LOGDIR / f"case{CASE}_g0723_{tag}.log"
    try:
        with open(logf, "w") as lf:
            p = subprocess.run(
                [PY, "mesh_one_dist_wrap.py", str(CASE), str(NPROC), str(size), str(a2), str(a3)],
                cwd=str(HERE), stdout=lf, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=CAP,
            )
        for line in reversed(logf.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()):
            if line.startswith("STATUS "):
                return json.loads(line[len("STATUS "):])
        return {"status": "failed", "error": f"no STATUS line (exit {p.returncode})"}
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return {"status": "timeout"}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"status": "failed", "error": f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"}


def main():
    if MARKER.exists():
        MARKER.unlink()
    print(f"[168-g0723] ladder on original geometry, rungs={RUNGS}", flush=True)
    result = {"case": CASE, "status": "failed"}
    for i, (size, a2, a3) in enumerate(RUNGS):
        st = attempt(size, a2, a3, f"r{i+1}")
        st.update({"mesh_size": size, "algo2d": a2, "algo3d": a3, "rung": i + 1, "ts": time.time()})
        with open(PROG, "a") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(st) + "\n")
        print(f"[rung {i+1}] size={size} algo=({a2},{a3}) -> {st.get('status')} "
              f"elem={st.get('num_elements')} min_q={st.get('min_quality')} "
              f"neg={st.get('neg_jacobian')} {st.get('seconds')}s "
              f"{str(st.get('error',''))[:70]}", flush=True)
        result = st
        if st.get("status") == "done":
            break
    MARKER.write_text("DONE\n")
    print(f"[168-g0723] COMPLETE final={result.get('status')}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""
Re-mesh 63, 215, 231 after the user regenerated FULL geometry (all 5 files,
2026-07-27 18:13) with lowered skewness AND DOS + fresh guideline lumen /
centerline solid. This targets the boolean/2D root cause (lumen was the source).

Per-case ladder (first success wins):
  * 63, 231 -- boolean failures before -> standard ladder, re-check the cut.
  * 215     -- 2D surface stall before -> Frontal-Delaunay (algo2d=6) first.
  * 231 lumen.stp is large (many B-spline ctrl pts) -> may be slower; 25min cap.
"""
import json
import time
import subprocess
import threading
from pathlib import Path
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PY = "/home/jeff/miniconda3/envs/ansys_new/bin/python"
NPROC = 12
WORKERS = 3
CAP = 1500  # 25 min per rung

PLANS = {
    63:  [(0.05, 5, 10), (0.06, 6, 10), (0.06, 5, 1)],
    231: [(0.05, 5, 10), (0.06, 6, 10), (0.06, 5, 1)],
    215: [(0.05, 6, 10), (0.05, 5, 10), (0.06, 6, 10)],
}
CASES = sorted(PLANS)

SOLID = HERE / "solid_0727"
LOGDIR = SOLID / "logs"; LOGDIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
PROG = SOLID / "batch_f_progress.jsonl"
STATUS = SOLID / "batch_f_status.json"
MARKER = SOLID / "batch_f.marker"

_lock = threading.Lock()
counts = {"total": len(CASES), "done": 0, "failed": 0, "timeout": 0,
          "skipped": 0, "running": 0}
start_time = time.time()


def msh_path(c):
    return SOLID / f"case_{c}" / "dist_run" / "solid_type_1_dist.msh"


def write_status():
    with _lock:
        s = dict(counts)
        s["start_time"] = start_time
        s["elapsed"] = round(time.time() - start_time, 1)
        STATUS.write_text(json.dumps(s, indent=2))


def record(entry):
    entry["ts"] = time.time()
    with _lock:
        with open(PROG, "a") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(entry) + "\n")
        st = entry.get("status")
        if st in counts:
            counts[st] += 1
    write_status()


def attempt(c, size, a2, a3, tag):
    logf = LOGDIR / f"case{c}_{tag}.log"
    try:
        with open(logf, "w") as lf:
            p = subprocess.run(
                [PY, "mesh_one_0727.py", str(c), str(NPROC), str(size), str(a2), str(a3)],
                cwd=str(HERE), stdout=lf, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=CAP,
            )
        for line in reversed(logf.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()):
            if line.startswith("STATUS "):
                return json.loads(line[len("STATUS "):])
        return {"status": "failed", "error": f"no STATUS line (exit {p.returncode})"}
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return {"status": "timeout"}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"status": "failed", "error": f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"}


def run_case(c):
    # remove any stale mesh so the new geometry re-meshes
    mp = msh_path(c)
    if mp.exists():
        mp.unlink()
    with _lock:
        counts["running"] += 1
    write_status()
    entry = {"case": c}
    try:
        for i, (size, a2, a3) in enumerate(PLANS[c]):
            st = attempt(c, size, a2, a3, f"f{i+1}")
            st.update({"mesh_size": size, "algo2d": a2, "algo3d": a3, "rung": i + 1})
            entry.update(st)
            if st.get("status") == "done":
                break
    finally:
        with _lock:
            counts["running"] -= 1
    record(entry)
    return entry


def main():
    if MARKER.exists():
        MARKER.unlink()
    write_status()
    print(f"[0727f] {len(CASES)} cases (63,215,231), FULL new geometry 18:13", flush=True)
    for c in CASES:
        print(f"  case {c}: {PLANS[c]}", flush=True)
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=WORKERS) as ex:
        futs = [ex.submit(run_case, c) for c in CASES]
        for fut in as_completed(futs):
            e = fut.result()
            print(f"[case {e.get('case')}] {e.get('status')} rung={e.get('rung')} "
                  f"size={e.get('mesh_size')} algo=({e.get('algo2d')},{e.get('algo3d')}) "
                  f"elem={e.get('num_elements')} min_q={e.get('min_quality')} "
                  f"neg={e.get('neg_jacobian')} {e.get('seconds')}s "
                  f"{str(e.get('error',''))[:70]}", flush=True)
    MARKER.write_text("DONE\n")
    write_status()
    print("[0727f] COMPLETE")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# Plan: Batch distance-field solid meshing (case 1–383) on cvbml01 + Notion live dashboard

## Context
We validated the **distance-field** Type-1 solid mesh recipe (`HXT_meshing_I_dist.py`: fc-surface Distance+Threshold sizing, `Smoothing=10`, `optimize('HighOrder')`) on case 0 — it eliminates negative-Jacobian elements (min quality −0.46 → +0.02) and cuts element count ~43% vs the box field. The full geometry set (384 cases, case_0–383, stp-only, 170M) is now on cvbml01 at `65_final_0723/geo_0723/`.

Goal: mesh **case 1 through 383** with the dist recipe, **save only the `.msh`** (skip the ~130MB vtu per case to save disk), run **4 cases in parallel (nproc 12 each)**, skip cases already meshed, continue past failures — and report progress to the Notion page **"🥌 HXT meshing1"** (`3a62a46dc68c80db83bad8bee57a85f9`) every 5 minutes as a live dashboard.

Constraints confirmed: cvbml01 has 463G free (dist msh ≈ 289MB/case → ~110–160GB total, fits); `ansys_new` conda env; `parameter.csv` (1000 rows) supplies `lesion_length` for every case.

## Files to create (on cvbml01 `/home/jeff/project/65_final_0723/`)

### 1. `mesh_one_dist.py` — single-case worker (msh only)
- Args: `<case> <nproc> <mesh_size>`.
- Import `gmshing_solid` from `HXT_meshing_I_dist` (unchanged), call with `save_vtu=False`.
- Output dir `solid_0723/case_<c>/dist_run/`. **Skip** (exit 0, status `skipped`) if `solid_type_1_dist.msh` already exists.
- On success: rename `solid_type_1.msh` → `solid_type_1_dist.msh` (**no vtu conversion**); `gmshing_solid` already writes `quality.json` (num_elements, min_quality, avg_quality, neg_jacobian_count, poor_count) into that dir.
- Print a final one-line JSON status (`{"case":c,"status":"done","num_elements":...,"min_quality":...,"neg_jacobian":...,"seconds":...}`) so the orchestrator can capture it; on exception print status `failed` with the message.

### 2. `batch_dist_0723.py` — orchestrator (4-wide)
- Range `range(1, 384)`; `ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4)`, each task runs `subprocess.run([py, "mesh_one_dist.py", str(c), "12", "0.05"], timeout=2400)` (40-min per-case cap).
- Skip-if-exists handled inside the worker (keeps resume trivial).
- Append one line per finished case to `solid_0723/batch_progress.jsonl` (`{case,status,num_elements,min_quality,neg_jacobian,seconds,ts}`); statuses: `done` / `failed` / `timeout` / `skipped`. `ts` passed in (avoid `Date.now` issues — orchestrator may use `time.time()` freely, this is real Python not a workflow script).
- Maintain `solid_0723/batch_status.json` summary (total, done, failed, timeout, running, start_time). Write a `batch_dist.marker` at the end.
- Launch with `nohup … &` under `PATH=/home/jeff/miniconda3/envs/ansys_new/bin:$PATH` (env activation, so any freecad/lib deps resolve), logging to `solid_0723/logs/batch_dist.log`; each case's gmsh stdout → `solid_0723/logs/case<c>_dist.log`.

Reuse (do **not** modify): `HXT_meshing_I_dist.py` (`gmshing_solid`), `54_analysis/pre_data/bin/parameter.csv`, the `ansys_new` env + `utils.utils_geo_mesh` editable install.

## Notion live dashboard — via `/loop 5m`
After the batch is launched, start `/loop 5m` with a report step that each cycle:
1. `ssh ws1` → read `batch_progress.jsonl` + count `solid_0723/case_*/dist_run/solid_type_1_dist.msh` + read running `case<c>_dist.log` tails → compute: done X/383, failed list, currently-running cases, recent ~10 completions (case, elem, min_q, neg_jac, sec), elapsed, ETA (remaining ÷ 4 × avg case time).
2. **Replace** the Notion page body (`notion-update-page`, id `3a62a46dc68c80db83bad8bee57a85f9`) with a fresh snapshot dashboard:
   - Header: last-updated time, elapsed, ETA.
   - Progress line: ✅ done / ❌ failed / ⏳ running / remaining out of 383.
   - Quality summary: how many meshes have neg-Jacobian = 0, worst min-quality seen.
   - Table: recent completions (case | #elem | min_q | neg-jac | sec).
   - Failures: list of failed/timeout cases (e.g. case_3 if it still fails STEP1).
- Stop the loop (and note it) once `batch_dist.marker` appears (all cases done) — final cycle posts the completed summary.

## Notes / expected issues
- **case_3** had a STEP1 boolean failure earlier; geometry was regenerated (14:59) and re-synced, so it will be re-attempted — logged as `failed` if it still fails, batch continues.
- Some long-lesion cases may hit the 40-min cap → `timeout`, logged, batch continues.
- Disk: monitor via the dashboard is out of scope, but ~110–160GB will be consumed; 463G free is enough.

## Verification
1. After launch: `ssh ws1 'tail solid_0723/logs/batch_dist.log; ls solid_0723/case_1/dist_run/'` → case_1 producing `solid_type_1_dist.msh` + `quality.json`, **no** `.vtu`.

3. `batch_progress.jsonl` grows with one JSON line per finished case; `neg_jacobian` should be 0 on successes.
4. Notion page "🥌 HXT meshing1" shows the dashboard and refreshes every ~5 min; failures (e.g. case_3) appear in the failures list.
5. Resume check: re-running the orchestrator skips cases whose `solid_type_1_dist.msh` exists.

## claude.ai Shopify
This server helps users set up and manage their Shopify stores.

## Store Creation
Users who don't have a store yet can use get-new-store-previews to create one from a short description.
After calling get-new-store-previews, encourage the user to browse the previews and pick the theme they like best.

Once a store exists, this server provides tools for managing it:

- Collections: search, create, update, and manage product groupings.
- Orders: list recent orders and get detailed order information.
- Customers: list and search customers.

The Shopify Admin API exposes hundreds of resources. The built-in tools above are optimized shortcuts for common operations (with structured output and widgets), but they only cover a subset of the API.

| | Box field (기존 409개와 동일) | Distance field (65_final 개선판) |
|---|---|---|

def gmshing_solid(lumen_stp_path, solid_stp_path, lipid_stp_path, fc_stp_path, save_folder_path, nproc = 5, 
                  Terminal_display = True, save_vtu = False, mesh_size = 0.04, lesion_length = 1.0):

    start_time = time.time()

    gmsh.initialize()
    gmsh.model.add("Stenosis Model")

    #Terminal display setting
    if Terminal_display:   
        gmsh.option.setNumber("General.Terminal", 1)   
    else:
        gmsh.option.setNumber("General.Verbosity", 0) 


    #STEP1: lipid n fc -> new fc
    lipid = gmsh.model.occ.importShapes(str(lipid_stp_path))[0]   #[(3,1)]
    gmsh.model.occ.synchronize()

    fc    = gmsh.model.occ.importShapes(str(fc_stp_path))[0]     #[(3,2)]
    gmsh.model.occ.synchronize()
    
    gmsh.model.occ.intersect([lipid], [fc], removeObject = False, removeTool = True) 
    gmsh.model.occ.synchronize()

    gmsh.model.occ.removeAllDuplicates() # Intersection of the lipid and fc varies the lipid core.
    gmsh.model.occ.synchronize()
    
    lipid = (3,3)


    #Check if the entities are in the volumes
    volumes = gmsh.model.getEntities(3)
    if lipid and fc in volumes:
        print("STEP1 complete, lipid and fc are in the volumes")
    else:
        raise Exception("STEP1 Failed.")


    '''
    fc - (3,2)
    lipid - (3,3)
    '''

    # #STEP3 fc - lumen -> new fc
    lumen = gmsh.model.occ.importShapes(str(lumen_stp_path))[0] #(3,4)
    gmsh.model.occ.synchronize()

    gmsh.model.occ.cut([fc], [lumen], removeObject = True, removeTool = False)
    gmsh.model.occ.synchronize()

    gmsh.model.occ.removeAllDuplicates()
    gmsh.model.occ.synchronize()


    volumes = gmsh.model.getEntities(3)
    if fc and lumen in volumes:
        print("STEP3 complete, fc and solid are in the volumes")
    else:
        raise Exception("STEP3 Failed.")
    


    #STEP4 solid - (lipid+fc+lumen) -> new solid
    solid = gmsh.model.occ.importShapes(str(solid_stp_path))[0]
    gmsh.model.occ.synchronize()

    gmsh.model.occ.cut([solid], [lipid, fc, lumen], removeObject = False, removeTool = False)
    gmsh.model.occ.synchronize()

    gmsh.model.occ.removeAllDuplicates()
    gmsh.model.occ.synchronize()

    solid = (3,6)

    volumes = set(gmsh.model.getEntities(3))


    solid = volumes - set([lipid, fc, lumen])
    
    if len(solid) != 1:
        raise Exception("STEP4 Failed.")
    else:
        print("STEP4 complete, solid is in the volumes")
        solid = solid.pop() # solid - (3,6)



    ############################################
    ############# PHYSICAL TAGGING #############
    ############################################
    gmsh.model.addPhysicalGroup(3, [solid[1]], tag=1, name="solid")
    gmsh.model.addPhysicalGroup(3, [lipid[1]], tag=2, name="lipid")
    gmsh.model.addPhysicalGroup(3, [fc[1]], tag=3, name="fc")

    # Extract volume tags from lumen
    lumen_volume_tags = [lumen[1]]

    # Get the boundary surfaces between solid and fc fc = (3,7)
    fc_surfaces    = [abs(s[1]) for s in gmsh.model.getBoundary([fc],    oriented=False)]
    solid_surfaces = [abs(s[1]) for s in gmsh.model.getBoundary([solid], oriented=False)]
    lipid_surfaces = [abs(s[1]) for s in gmsh.model.getBoundary([lipid], oriented=False)]

    wall_in_fc_tags    = utils.find_wall_surfaces(fc_surfaces,    lumen_volume_tags)
    wall_in_solid_tags = utils.find_wall_surfaces(solid_surfaces, lumen_volume_tags)  
    gmsh.model.occ.synchronize()

    lipid_in_fc_tags = list(set(lipid_surfaces) & set(fc_surfaces))
    gmsh.model.addPhysicalGroup(2, wall_in_fc_tags, tag=5, name="wall_in_fc")
    gmsh.model.addPhysicalGroup(2, wall_in_solid_tags, tag=4, name="wall_in_solid")
    gmsh.model.addPhysicalGroup(2, lipid_in_fc_tags, tag=7, name="lipid_in_fc")
    gmsh.model.occ.synchronize()
     
    all_solid_surfaces = gmsh.model.getBoundary([solid], oriented=False)

    surface_centers = []
    for surface in all_solid_surfaces:
        com = gmsh.model.occ.getCenterOfMass(surface[0], abs(surface[1]))
        surface_centers.append(com[2])

    # Convert to numpy array for easy math
    surface_centers = np.array(surface_centers)

    # Find indices closest to -20.0 and +80.0
    side1_index = np.argmin(np.abs(surface_centers - (-20.0)))
    side2_index = np.argmin(np.abs(surface_centers - 80.0))

    # Correct: pick from all_solid_surfaces, not from surface_centers
    side1_surface = all_solid_surfaces[side1_index]
    side2_surface = all_solid_surfaces[side2_index]

    # Add physical group for inlet and outlet
    gmsh.model.addPhysicalGroup(2, [abs(side1_surface[1]), abs(side2_surface[1])], tag=6, name="Two_sides")
    gmsh.model.occ.synchronize()

    #remove lumen
    gmsh.model.occ.remove([lumen])
    gmsh.model.occ.synchronize()

    #CHECK The physical groups are all in the list
    physical_groups = gmsh.model.getPhysicalGroups(3)
    for (dim, tag) in physical_groups:
        if tag not in [1,2,3]:
            raise Exception(f"(dim = 3)Physical group {tag} is not in the list")

    for (dim, tag) in gmsh.model.getPhysicalGroups(2):
        if tag not in [4,5,6,7]:
            raise Exception(f"(dim = 2)Physical group {tag} is not in the list")
   

    ####################################
    ############# MESHING ##############
    ####################################
    '''

        B. Meshing Procedures
            1. Generate distance field (Criteria: wall_in_fc  or all_fc_faces)
            2. Generate threshold field from the distance field
            3. Set mesh options as below.
            4. Generate mesh
            5. save as msh file
            6. save as vtu file(0.1 scaled)
        
        #Mesh options need to be considered
            1. Fibrou cap mesh size - 0.05, other wise 0.1
            2. Number of CPU cores - 32 if available > 32, otherwise 10.
            3. Smoothing must be used in order to get a posiive Jacobi ratio.
            4. Quadratic tetra
        
        [Mesh Algorithm Types]
        1	Delaunay	        The fastest, handles complex mesh size fields well (default)
        4	Frontal	            Front-based, generates cleaner elements for boundary shapes
        5	Frontal Delaunay	Mix of Delaunay and Frontal for higher quality
        6	Frontal Hex	        Specify on hexa Generation 
        7	MMG3D	            External MMG library based adaptive mesh reconstruction

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""Single-case LAP (Type-1 solid) mesher, distance-field recipe.
Reads solid_data/case_<c>/{lumen,solid,lipid,fc}.stp + lesion_length from
pre_data/parameter_0728.csv (row index == case_id), meshes via
HXT_meshing_I_dist.gmshing_solid, then moves solid_type_1.msh ->
LAP_mesh/solid_LAP_<c>.msh. Prints one final `STATUS {json}` line.

Usage: mesh_one_LAP.py <case> <nproc> <mesh_size> [algo2d] [algo3d]
Skips (status=skipped) if LAP_mesh/solid_LAP_<c>.msh already exists.
"""
import sys, os, io, json, time, shutil, contextlib
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CSV = HERE / "pre_data" / "parameter_0728.csv"
LAPDIR = HERE / "LAP_mesh"


def main():
    case = int(sys.argv[1])
    nproc = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 12
    size = float(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 0.055
    algo2d = int(sys.argv[4]) if len(sys.argv) > 4 else 5
    algo3d = int(sys.argv[5]) if len(sys.argv) > 5 else 10

    out = LAPDIR / f"solid_LAP_{case}.msh"
    if out.exists():
        print("STATUS " + json.dumps({"case": case, "status": "skipped"}))
        return

    d = HERE / "solid_data" / f"case_{case}"
    df = pd.read_csv(str(CSV))
    lesion = float(df.loc[case, "lesion_length"])

    import HXT_meshing_I_dist as M
    t0 = time.time()
    buf = io.StringIO()
    try:
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
            msh = M.gmshing_solid(
                d / "lumen.stp", d / "solid.stp", d / "lipid.stp", d / "fc.stp",
                d, nproc, True, False, size, lesion, algo2d, algo3d,
            )
    except Exception as e:
        sys.stdout.write(buf.getvalue()[-4000:])
        print("STATUS " + json.dumps({
            "case": case, "status": "failed", "mesh_size": size,
            "algo2d": algo2d, "algo3d": algo3d,
            "error": f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}", "seconds": round(time.time() - t0, 1),
        }))
        return

    txt = buf.getvalue()
    sys.stdout.write(txt[-4000:])

    # prefer quality.json (written by the dist mesher)
    n_elem = min_q = avg_q = neg = poor = None
    qj = d / "quality.json"
    if qj.exists():
        try:
            q = json.loads(qj.read_text())
            n_elem = q.get("num_elements"); min_q = q.get("min_quality")
            avg_q = q.get("avg_quality"); neg = q.get("neg_jacobian_count")
            poor = q.get("poor_count")
        except Exception:
            pass

    LAPDIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    shutil.move(str(msh), str(out))

    st = {
        "case": case, "status": "done", "mesh_size": size,
        "algo2d": algo2d, "algo3d": algo3d,
        "num_elements": n_elem, "min_quality": min_q, "avg_quality": avg_q,
        "neg_jacobian": neg, "poor_count": poor,
        "seconds": round(time.time() - t0, 1),
    }
    print("STATUS " + json.dumps(st))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

완전히 진단됐습니다. `done`이 안 오르는 이유와 실패 유형이 명확합니다.

## 왜 done=2에서 정체됐나
- **case 30, 40**: rung-1(0.055)에서 **10분 상한을 꽉 채우고 timeout** → 지금 rung-2(0.06 + Frontal-Delaunay)로 재시도 중. 멈춘 게 아니라 **설계대로 사다리 타는 중** (무거운 형상)
- 즉 무거운 2개가 워커 2개를 10분씩 잡아먹어서 처리량이 잠깐 눌림

## 실패 5건 — 전부 geometry 문제 ✅ (가설 적중)
| 유형 | case | 성격 |
|---|---|---|
| STEP4 boolean | 8, 13, 48 | 즉시 실패, 볼륨 컷 불가 |
| **Invalid boundary (overlapping facets)** | 3, 23 | BSpline 표면 자기교차/겹침 = **형상 결함** |
| HXT 3D failed | 49 | rung-3(Delaunay 3D)로 살아날 여지 있음 |

→ **재생성 대상은 지금까지 최소 5개** (3, 8, 13, 23, 48). 말씀대로 geometry 실패가 다수입니다.

## 참고 (개선 여지)
- `overlapping facets`(3, 23) 같은 **형상 결함**은 알고리즘으로 못 살립니다 — 그런데 제 early-break는 "STEP" 에러만 즉시 중단하고, 이건 사다리 3단을 다 태우고서야 실패 처리됩니다(시간 낭비). 지금 배치는 그대로 두고(재시작하면 진행 중 작업 손실), 남은 구간에서 이런 케이스가 많으면 그때 early-break 확장을 고려하겠습니다.
- 성공 메시는 전부 **neg-Jacobian 0**, 품질 양호.

배치는 건강하게 진행 중입니다. 계속 모니터링하고 유의미한 변화 시 보고드리겠습니다. 무거운 tail 때문에 완료는 처음 추정보다 다소 길어질 수 있습니다(10분 상한 × 사다리).
